name: One Craft
tagline: Set sail across the Blue Planet

news.title: One Craft 0.4.1 update
lines: A clock and date now sit beside your status plate. Every voyage starts on 1 January 1755.
Press ] to open the calendar: the month at a glance, moon phases, season and today's weather.
New Settings button (the cogwheel on your Character Record): change the size of the menus and HUD, and switch HUD pieces and camera effects on or off.
The Bounty Board is for Marines only. Everyone else can buy a newspaper from a News Coo to see who's wanted.
Your fighting style is picked in the character creator and kept for good, unless the server allows changing it.
Harbours are built on cleaner ground: no more pits, puddles and bare dirt patches around the docks.
One Craft is now played on the official server only, so everyone shares the same Blue Planet.
Played during the beta? You now wear a gold BETA badge by your name in chat and the player list, for good.
Simple Voice Chat now comes with the launcher: talk to players near you. Press V to set it up the first time, and hold Caps Lock to talk.
Minecraft capes now hang properly from your character while running, instead of sliding down your back.
RP Essentials 1.2: the server now keeps a log of who breaks and places blocks, so staff can check and undo griefing, and autoclickers are caught.

news.title: One Craft 0.4.1
lines: Just Enough Items (JEI) now comes with the launcher, so you can look up any recipe in game.
Buy land for your crew: plant a Crew Flag, then right-click it to buy the chunks around it with Beli.
Crew Flags fly your Jolly Roger, and you can now import a picture as your Jolly Roger in the crew menu.
Every port's starter chest now holds a Sea Chart, and Sea Charts craft from 3 paper and any dye.
RP Essentials 1.1: /sethome, /home, /spawn and /back, veinmining (hold the ` key while mining) and fast leaf decay.
Ships sail at a steadier pace: the wind still helps or slows you, and storms no longer wreck your speed.
Fixes for Marine sail lettering, draped coats and boots while running, and getting stuck in the harbour on your first spawn.
Worlds made before 0.4.1 lose their One Craft blocks and items, so start a new world.

news.title: One Craft Launcher 1.1.0
lines: Sign in with your Microsoft account right here in the launcher, then PLAY starts One Craft directly. This turns on as soon as Mojang approves the launcher.
Until then, PLAY keeps using the official Minecraft Launcher, just like before.
Faster game settings out of the box: tuned Java memory cleanup for smoother play.
Settings has a new switch to keep using the official Minecraft Launcher if you prefer it.

news.title: One Craft Launcher 1.0.0
lines: The One Craft Launcher is here. Press PLAY and it sets up NeoForge, GeckoLib, RP Essentials and One Craft for you.
Mods update themselves: every time you press PLAY the launcher checks for a newer One Craft and downloads it.
One Craft keeps its own game folder, so your other Minecraft worlds and mods are never touched.
Sign-in goes through the official Minecraft Launcher. Pick the One Craft profile there and press Play.

news.title: One Craft 0.4.0
lines: Horses got a full visual rework: longer manes, fuller tails and feathered hooves.
Studs and spawn eggs for all 15 horse breeds, smaller wild herds and leather drops.
A themed riding HUD while you're in the saddle.
